question: After resolving conflicts, should maintainers land this structured bypass path with focused validation, or require live Telegram proof first?
rationale: The code path is the right owner boundary, but the branch is currently conflicting and the diff changes cron delivery/session-state behavior that green unit checks alone do not fully settle.

options.title: Refresh And Validate
options.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve delivery-awareness handling, rerun the focused cron and embedded-runner validation, then continue maintainer review.

options.title: Require Telegram Proof
options.body: Hold merge until Mantis or equivalent live Telegram proof shows the self-debug text is not sent to the target topic.

options.title: Pause The Branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but paused if maintainers want to combine it with broader cron required-tool fail-closed work instead.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Validate
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve delivery-awareness handling, rerun the focused cron and embedded-runner validation, then continue maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current fix branch and are assigned on the live PR, making them the best first owner for conflict refresh and validation decisions.
